source_evidence: State law gives you a set number of days (usually 10 to 30 days) to change your mind about buying an annuity after you receive the annuity contract.
question: What is an annuity free look period?
answer: It is a period after you receive the annuity contract when state law gives you a set number of days—usually 10 to 30—to change your mind about buying the annuity. The contract should state the length of the period and how to return it.
